answer: A forge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the atlas of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the bridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work.
